title: Fundamentals Of Business Education
modules: Business Education Programme In Other Countries
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is composed of a sequence of jobs that make up your career plan.
A career path is composed of a sequence of jobs that make up your career plan.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a process in which students learn by working in small groups and helping each other's learning for a common aim.
Cooperative teaching is a process in which students learn by working in small groups and helping each other's learning for a common aim.
Fill in the blank: ______ is an important facility for all business education programme especially in the 21st century.
Computer is an important facility for all business education programme especially in the 21st century.
fib: ______ is the implementation of organisational pattern, learning activities and resources to assist students in achieving their goal as effectively as possible.
Teaching strategy according to Popham is the implementation of organisational pattern, learning activities and resources to assist students in achieving their goal as effectively as possible.
______ is a student centred and activity-oriented teaching method in which the teacher guides through problem solving approach to discover answers to the questions.
The guided discovery method is a student centred and activity-oriented teaching method in which the teacher guides through problem solving approach to discover answers to the questions.
______ are made up of skilled and non-skilled subjects and as such should involve practical and theoretical orientation in order to realise the goal of the programme.
Business education subjects are made up of skilled and non-skilled subjects and as such should involve practical and theoretical orientation in order to realise the goal of the programme.
